title: Noise-area breakout improvement round on real ES/NQ futures, with a development / judgement split
registered: 2026-10-20, before any Gen134 number. Gen125 primary failed (ES+NQ 0.92 / 1.17 / 0.16); Gen126 NQ 2010-17 net -0.45 (gross +0.82)

variants.V1: check_minutes 60 (half the trades -> lower cost drag)
variants.V3: vwap_stop off (boundary stop only: fewer exits and re-entries)

selection: the variant with the highest Sharpe on the ES+NQ average over the DEVELOPMENT period 2018-01..2023-12 only (net, registered costs)
judgement: the selected variant is judged ONCE: ES+NQ average 2024-01..2026-09 Sharpe >= 0.5 AND NQ 2010-06..2017-12 Sharpe >= 0.3 net (costs = futures_db.cost_frac at the median price of each period). Nothing else is selected or re-run after the judgement
